newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firm, fuel oil by $4.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, fuel oil by $4.

text.p: NWE oil products all firmed on Friday, lighter products ticking up with futures strength, while fuel oil gained $4 a tonne, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil traded at $86 fob Rotterdam and in the range $84-$84.50 fob Flushing. Some traders said the gains were a reaction to a late sharp rise on crude gains on Thursday.
Others speculated that the Rotterdam buyers, both trading houses, were aiming to benefit other positions.
Heating oil barges were about $1 a tonne firmer as IPE May futures strengthened. Prompt offers were at around May +75/+$1 fob Rotterdam.
